Name: Prompts_01_FirstSightMarket
overlord_bark: The stalls, goblin. Their whole livelihood, stacked in wicker and waiting. Light it. …adequate.
hud_line: Market — burn the stalls: one of three targets. Torch: Q, then LMB

Name: Prompts_02_FirstSightWheatField
overlord_bark: The wheat is fat and smug. Fire runs in rows — let it run.
hud_line: Wheat field — burn the crop: fire spreads row to row. Torch: Q

Name: Prompts_03_FirstSightWindmill
overlord_bark: Her sails first, goblin. A landmark is only useful to me on fire.
hud_line: Windmill — light the frame: Stage 1, Ablaze. Torch: Q

Name: Prompts_11_FirstSightStatue
overlord_bark: Behold the dragonslayer, goblin. A lump of rock with a haircut. Fire won't touch him; stone doesn't care. Hook him and stroll. ...adequate.
hud_line: King's Statue: pull it down, the lie falls with it — Grapple (Q)

Name: Prompts_04_WindmillStage1Ablaze
overlord_bark: Her skin's alight, goblin, but it's the dust in her belly that'll bring her down — put fire through a window.
hud_line: Windmill: Ablaze — needs a window shot. Aimed torch throw: Q

Name: Prompts_05_FirstSightForestPatrol
overlord_bark: Torchlight in the trees. A patrol is a thing you choose to meet, goblin.
hud_line: Patrol ahead — crouch in cover: a broken look is no alarm. Crouch

Name: Prompts_06_FirstSightUnawareGuard
overlord_bark: Behind him. Quietly. The county will miss him eventually.
hud_line: Unaware guard — take him down: silent, but the body still talks. Hold F behind him

Name: Prompts_07_FirstSightCivilian
overlord_bark: Ten pounds of nothing in an apron, goblin. She cannot hurt you — but she can run, and she can point.
hud_line: Civilian — unarmed, and a witness. Take her down from behind. Hold F

Name: Prompts_08_FirstSightLivestockPen
overlord_bark: Their wealth has trotters. Take it by the middle and don't listen to it.
hud_line: Pig in the pen — sling it over your shoulder: +40 loot. Hold F

Name: Prompts_09_FirstCourierCargoAndHorde
overlord_bark: Let a lesser goblin do the walking. Your hands are wanted for arson.
hud_line: Point a goblin at the pig and it couriers the loot home. Order wheel: R

Name: Prompts_10_StatueHooked
overlord_bark: Forty feet of stone, and the man was five foot four. Lean on the rope, goblin. Let us see how a god holds his footing. ...adequate.
hud_line: Statue: Hooked — walk away to pull it down
